description.value: Passive (Mal voice). Gilbert's mop has 50/50 precognition for any spilled fluid. Once per scene, Gilbert may name the next bodily fluid that will hit the floor and where; if right, he sweeps it before it lands. One PC in the scene may then reroll-lowest on any check involving footing, balance, or a cleanly-finished moment. Mop says: "Already had it. Already there."

sources: Gilbert, Eternally Cleaning Not Leaning Theater Attendant
